title: State persistence
js: const key='bci:project-state:v1',status=root.querySelector('[data-status]'); const valid=x=>x&&typeof x.title==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.cards)&&x.cards.every(v=>typeof v==='string'); const save=()=>{const data={title:api.getState('title'),cards:api.getState('cards')};localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(data));status.textContent='Saved title and cards.';}; try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);if(raw){const saved=JSON.parse(raw);if(valid(saved)){api.setState('title',saved.title);api.setState('cards',[...saved.cards]);status.textContent='Restored saved title and cards.';}else status.textContent='Saved state was invalid and ignored.';}else status.textContent='No saved state yet.';}catch{status.textContent='Saved state could not be read.';} root.querySelector('[data-save]').addEventListener('click',save);root.querySelector('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>{localStorage.removeItem(key);status.textContent='Saved state cleared.';});window.addEventListener('pagehide',save,{once:true});
